title: Framework for thinking
description: A framework for thinking, at frameworks/<id>/framework.json: its vocabulary, its questions (frames), a template and how each of its answers lands in canonical records (maps_to). A framework reads and writes the canonical schema and never changes it (Torian, 2026-10-30). schema/check-frameworks.mjs checks that every maps_to targets a canonical route.

vocabulary.description: The framework's own terms and what each means in canonical words

answers.description: The framework field the answer fills

skill.description: The skill that runs the framework with the founder; it stays at its layer path

adapter.description: A module rendering the framework's view from canonical records

checks.description: Checks that belong to the framework and may read its own fields
